# OmniControl PC - LLM & AI Agent Guide

> This file follows the llms.txt standard to help autonomous AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode, Hermes, Antigravity) understand, install, and execute OmniControl PC.

## Overview
- Project: OmniControl PC (https://github.com/Wagustin/omnicontrolpc)
- Purpose: Ultralight (~35MB) On-Device System Assistant & Tool Engine for macOS and Windows.
- Core Engine: Cactus Compute Needle 3 (Simple Attention Network, 20 layers, CQ W4 STE + A8 quantized weights).
- License: Apache-2.0
- Memory Footprint: ~94 MB RAM (runs on low-end hardware, e.g., Intel Core i3 7th Gen / 8GB RAM and Apple Silicon M-series).
- Inference Latency: < 28 ms (on-device, 100% offline).

## Autonomous Agent Quick Install

### For macOS (Apple Silicon ARM64):
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wagustin/omnicontrolpc/main/install.sh | bash
```

### For Windows (x86_64):
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wagustin/omnicontrolpc/main/install.ps1 | iex"
```

## Tool Schemas
The tool specifications live at `schemas/tools.json`:
1. `find_files`: Fast document/file search via macOS Spotlight (`mdfind`) or Windows Everything (`es.exe`).
2. `open_target`: Launch application, file, or URL.
3. `system_control`: Set volume (0-100), mute/unmute, take screenshot, lock screen.
4. `study_notes`: Search or create markdown notes in Obsidian vault.
5. `delegate_kathy`: Escalate complex reasoning / code / email tasks to senior AI.

## Verification & Health Check
After installation, verify with:
```bash
python jarvis_client.py "sube el volumen al 50%"
```
Expected output: JSON function call matching `system_control` with `{"action": "set_volume", "level": 50}` executed in <30ms.
